mainEntity.name: Do I need an accountant for my SMSF?

acceptedAnswer.text: An SMSF must be audited annually by an independent approved auditor, and the annual return must be lodged by a registered agent. Most trustees use an SMSF specialist accountant to prepare accounts, coordinate the audit, and lodge the return. If your fund has property (LRBA) or balances near the $3m Division 296 threshold, specialist advice is strongly recommended.

mainEntity.name: How much does SMSF accounting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Annual SMSF accounting and audit typically ranges from $1,500 to $3,500 depending on complexity — more if the fund holds property, has borrowings, or needs Division 296 modelling. The matched specialist will give you a clear quote after reviewing your fund. The matching service itself is free.

mainEntity.name: Can my SMSF accountant also handle my personal tax?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes — many SMSF specialists also handle the personal tax of fund members. In the questionnaire, tell us if you want a firm that handles both your SMSF and personal return and we will match accordingly, or we will connect you with two specialists who coordinate.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched SMSF specialist contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched SMSF specialist will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your fund.

mainEntity.name: Can an SMSF accountant help with Division 296 planning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. From 1 July 2026 (the 2026–27 financial year onward), funds with member balances above $3 million face additional tax on earnings under Division 296. The matched specialist models the impact and advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and restructuring options.

mainEntity.name: Can an SMSF accountant help with pension setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched specialist establishes retirement-phase pensions, advises on minimum drawdowns, and ensures the pension documentation and tax treatment are correct — so you maximise the tax-free earnings in retirement phase.

Yes. The matching service is free for individuals and businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched specialist, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: What if my SMSF is behind on its annual return?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us in the questionnaire. Our network includes SMSF specialists experienced in bringing overdue fund returns and audits current — preparing the financial statements, coordinating the independent audit, and lodging outstanding years in sequence.

blocks.heading: SMSF Accountant — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKSMSF Accountant — what we can help withWhat an SMSF accountant doesAn SMSF specialist handles fund setup, annual accounts, tax return lodgement, independent audit coordination, pension establishment, contribution management, and compliance with the SIS Act and ATO rules. With Division 296 now applying to balances above $3m and Payday Super rolling out, specialist oversight has never been more important. Our matched specialists stay across these changes so you do not have to.Division 296 and balances over $3mFrom 1 July 2026, Division 296 applies an additional 15% tax (30% total) on earnings within an SMSF when a member's total super balance exceeds $3 million. If your fund is approaching or above this threshold, specialist advice on contribution strategy, pension structuring, and balance management is essential. Our network includes SMSF specialists who model Division 296 outcomes.Audit independenceAn SMSF requires an independent auditor each year — someone separate from the accountant preparing the accounts. Our matched firms coordinate an independent auditor on your behalf while maintaining the required separation. You never need to source the auditor yourself.
